name: create_payment_refund
description: Issue a full or partial refund for a processed Stripe payment charge.

charge_id.description: The unique identifier of the payment charge to refund (e.g., ch_1Mkj23).

amount_cents.description: The amount to refund in cents (e.g., 2500 for $25.00).

refund_application_fee.description: Whether to refund the application fee.

query: Please refund $45.00 for payment charge ch_99281a because the customer requested it.

name: create_repository_issue
description: Create a new tracking issue in a specified GitHub repository.

owner.description: The GitHub account or organization owner of the repository.

repo.description: The name of the repository without the owner prefix.

title.description: A short, descriptive title for the issue.

body.description: The detailed markdown contents explaining the issue.

query: Open an issue in facebook/react titled 'Fix synthetic event leak' describing the memory leak on unmount.

name: send_slack_channel_message
description: Post a formatted text message to a public or private Slack channel.

channel_id.description: The Slack channel ID (e.g. C0123456789) to post the message to.

message_text.description: The content of the message to send.

as_user.description: Pass true to post the message as the authenticated user instead of as a bot.

thread_ts.description: Provide another message's ts value to make this message a reply.

query: Post 'Deployment pipeline failed on step 4' to the alerts channel C08219941 as a bot.

name: scale_kubernetes_deployment
description: Scale the replica count of a named Kubernetes deployment in a target namespace.

namespace.description: The target Kubernetes namespace (e.g., prod, staging, default).

deployment_name.description: The exact name of the deployment workload to scale.

replicas.description: The desired number of pod replicas.

dry_run.description: If true, simulates the scale operation without applying changes.

query: Scale the api-gateway deployment in production namespace to 8 pods immediately.

name: create_s3_storage_bucket
description: Provision a new Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3) bucket in a target AWS region.

bucket_name.description: Globally unique DNS-compliant name for the new S3 bucket.

region.description: The AWS geographic region where the bucket will be hosted.

enable_versioning.description: Whether to turn on object versioning.

query: Create an S3 bucket named 'analytics-warehouse-2026' in us-east-1 with versioning enabled.

name: execute_database_sql_query
description: Execute a safe read or write SQL query against a PostgreSQL database cluster.

sql_query.description: The raw SQL statement to execute.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum execution time before aborting in seconds.

read_only.description: Enforces read-only transaction mode when true.

query: Run 'SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE active = true LIMIT 50' on the analytics_db with a 30s timeout as read only.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE active = true LIMIT 50

name: update_crm_customer_lead
description: Update the pipeline status and deal estimate for a sales lead.

lead_id.description: The alphanumeric CRM lead identifier (e.g., LEAD-8812).

deal_value_usd.description: Estimated total contract value in USD.

query: Move lead LEAD-401 to qualified stage with an estimated contract value of 120000 dollars.

name: generate_shipping_label
description: Create a freight or parcel shipping label with an integrated carrier.
query: Generate a FedEx shipping label for a 4.5 lb box going to zip code 75001 using priority_overnight delivery.

name: transition_jira_ticket
description: Advance a Jira software ticket through the active sprint workflow.

ticket_key.description: The project key and issue number (e.g., ENG-4921).

query: Move ticket ENG-1049 to code_review with notes stating PR #42 is ready.

name: create_datadog_monitor_alert
description: Configure an automated monitoring rule and threshold alert in Datadog.

metric_name.description: The exact telemetry metric time series to monitor.

critical_threshold.description: The numeric threshold boundary triggering a critical page.

notify_channel.description: Target Slack or PagerDuty channel hook.

query: Set a Datadog alert on system.cpu.utilization when it exceeds 85.0 over a 15 minute window.

name: send_twilio_sms_message
description: Dispatch an outbound SMS message via the Twilio Messaging API.

message_body.description: Plain text message content up to 1600 characters.

sender_id.description: Twilio assigned shortcode or registered phone number.

query: Send an SMS to +14693636353 saying 'Your verification code is 492011'.

name: create_zendesk_support_ticket
description: Submit a customer support helpdesk ticket to Zendesk.
query: Create an urgent Zendesk ticket for alice@example.com with subject 'Cannot login to account' describing 500 error on sign-in.

name: add_mailchimp_newsletter_subscriber
description: Subscribe an email contact to an audience marketing list in Mailchimp.
query: Subscribe bob@acme.org to audience list LIST-994 as subscribed with first name Bob.

name: purge_cloudflare_cdn_cache
description: Invalidate cached assets across Cloudflare edge data centers.

purge_everything.description: When true, clears the entire edge cache for the zone.

target_urls.description: List of specific URL assets to purge.

query: Purge the entire CDN cache for Cloudflare zone zone_abc123.

name: trigger_pagerduty_incident
description: Fire a high-priority incident alert to on-call engineering engineers.

incident_title.description: Concise headline describing the service interruption.

details.description: Stack trace, metrics snapshot, or contextual error message.

query: Trigger a high urgency PagerDuty incident on service SVC-881 titled 'Database connection pool exhausted'.

name: create_auth0_directory_user
description: Provision a new user identity record in an Auth0 database connection.

email_verified.description: Sets whether the email has already been verified.

query: Create an Auth0 user with email charlie@corp.io in 'Username-Password-Authentication' connection with email_verified set to false.

name: index_elasticsearch_document
description: Insert or replace a JSON document into an Elasticsearch cluster index.

refresh.description: Whether to force immediate shard refresh.

query: Index a document with id 'doc_4492' into the 'products_v2' Elasticsearch index with refresh enabled.

name: create_notion_database_page
description: Create a new row or sub-page in a Notion relational workspace database.

database_id.description: UUID of the parent Notion database.

archived.description: Whether the new page should be archived.

query: Create a Notion page titled 'Q4 System Architecture Review' in database db_38192a with status in_progress.

name: run_docker_container
description: Instantiate and run a software container from an OCI Docker image.

image_name.description: Docker registry image name with tag (e.g., redis:7-alpine).

detached.description: Run container in background daemon mode.

query: Run a container named 'cache-redis' from image 'redis:7.2' with restart policy set to always in detached mode.

name: create_shopify_discount_code
description: Generate an automated coupon discount code for a Shopify merchant storefront.

discount_code.description: The customer-facing promo code string (e.g. SUMMER20).

usage_limit.description: Total allowable redemptions across all customers.

query: Create a percentage discount code 'FLASH25' for 25.0 percent off with a usage limit of 500 redemptions.
